   216→        )
   217→        has_selected_tags = len(unique_selected_tags) > 0
   218→        unselected_tags = set(unique_tags).symmetric_difference(unique_selected_tags)
   219→        groups = TagGroup.create_tag_groups(unselected_tags)
   220→
   221→        self.tags = unique_tags

class TagCloudGroupingPreferenceTest(TestCase, BookmarkFactoryMixin, HtmlTestMixin):
    def render_template(
        self,
        context_type: Type[contexts.TagCloudContext] = contexts.ActiveTagCloudContext,
        url: str = "/test",
        user: User | None = None,
    ):
        rf = RequestFactory()
        request = rf.get(url)
        request.user = user or self.get_or_create_test_user()
        middleware = UserProfileMiddleware(lambda r: None)
        middleware(request)

        tag_cloud_context = context_type(request)
        context = RequestContext(request, {"tag_cloud": tag_cloud_context})
        template_to_render = Template("{% include 'bookmarks/tag_cloud.html' %}")
        return template_to_render.render(context)

    def test_disable_tag_cloud_grouping_renders_single_group(self):
        # Create tags across multiple starting letters
        tags = [
            self.setup_tag(name="Cockatoo"),
            self.setup_tag(name="Badger"),
            self.setup_tag(name="Buffalo"),
            self.setup_tag(name="Chihuahua"),
            self.setup_tag(name="Alpaca"),
            self.setup_tag(name="Coyote"),
            self.setup_tag(name="Aardvark"),
            self.setup_tag(name="Bumblebee"),
            self.setup_tag(name="Armadillo"),
        ]
        self.setup_bookmark(tags=tags)

        # Disable grouping preference on the user's profile
        user = self.get_or_create_test_user()
        profile = user.profile
        profile.search_preferences = {"group_tag_cloud": False}

                    "Badger",
                    "Buffalo",
                    "Bumblebee",
                    "Chihuahua",
                    "Cockatoo",
                    "Coyote",
                ]
            ],
        )

class TagCloudGroupingPreferenceTest(TestCase, BookmarkFactoryMixin, HtmlTestMixin):
    def render_template(
        self,
        context_type: Type[contexts.TagCloudContext] = contexts.ActiveTagCloudContext,
        url: str = "/test",
        user: User | None = None,
    ):
        rf = RequestFactory()
        request = rf.get(url)
        request.user = user or self.get_or_create_test_user()
        middleware = UserProfileMiddleware(lambda r: None)
        middleware(request)

        tag_cloud_context = context_type(request)
        context = RequestContext(request, {"tag_cloud": tag_cloud_context})
        template_to_render = Template("{% include 'bookmarks/tag_cloud.html' %}")
        return template_to_render.render(context)

    def assertTagGroups(self, rendered_template: str, groups: list[list[str]]):
        soup = self.make_soup(rendered_template)
        group_elements = soup.select("p.group")

        self.assertEqual(len(group_elements), len(groups))

        for group_index, tags in enumerate(groups, start=0):
            group_element = group_elements[group_index]
            link_elements = group_element.select("a")

            self.assertEqual(len(link_elements), len(tags))

            for tag_index, tag in enumerate(tags, start=0):
                link_element = link_elements[tag_index]
                self.assertEqual(link_element.text.strip(), tag)

    def test_disable_tag_cloud_grouping_renders_single_group(self):
        # Create tags across multiple starting letters
        tags = [
            self.setup_tag(name="Cockatoo"),
            self.setup_tag(name="Badger"),
            self.setup_tag(name="Buffalo"),
            self.setup_tag(name="Chihuahua"),
            self.setup_tag(name="Alpaca"),
            self.setup_tag(name="Coyote"),
            self.setup_tag(name="Aardvark"),
            self.setup_tag(name="Bumblebee"),
            self.setup_tag(name="Armadillo"),
        ]
        self.setup_bookmark(tags=tags)

        # Disable grouping preference on the user's profile
        user = self.get_or_create_test_user()
        profile = user.profile
        profile.search_preferences = {"group_tag_cloud": False}
        profile.save()

        rendered_template = self.render_template(user=user)

        # Expect a single group containing all tags sorted alphabetically
        self.assertTagGroups(
            rendered_template,
            [
                [
                    "Aardvark",
                    "Alpaca",
                    "Armadillo",
                    "Badger",
                    "Buffalo",
                    "Bumblebee",
                    "Chihuahua",
                    "Cockatoo",
                    "Coyote",
                ]
            ],
        )
